project.title: Quarter-End Financial Close Process Streamlining
project.objective: Standardise and speed up the quarter-end close while improving accuracy and compliance across bookkeeping and planning activities.
deliverables: Documented quarter-end close workflow with RACI
Standard journal entry and reconciliation templates
Reporting package structure for management review
constraints: Must be ready before the next quarter-end close cycle
All changes must comply with tax legislation and commercial law
No changes to core accounting system configuration
Minimal disruption to ongoing monthly bookkeeping work
Templates must be usable by both bookkeeping and planning staff

risks.risk: Incomplete mapping of current close activities leads to gaps in the new process.
risks.mitigation: Run walkthrough sessions with all bookkeepers and accountant; validate workflow against prior close checklists and statutory obligations.

risks.risk: New templates are too complex and not adopted by the team.
risks.mitigation: Pilot templates in a mock close, gather feedback from users, and simplify before final rollout.

risks.risk: Tight deadline conflicts with regular quarter preparation work.
risks.mitigation: Timebox workshops, prioritise critical steps first, and stagger tasks to avoid peak workload days.

risks.risk: Compliance issues if guidelines conflict with tax or commercial law.
risks.mitigation: Accountant reviews all process changes and templates against legal and statutory requirements before approval.

themes.why_relevant: Aligns how bookkeepers and planners execute quarter-end tasks, reducing errors and rework.
Ensures the streamlined process still meets tax, commercial law, and reporting requirements.
Core to making the new process repeatable, auditable, and easy to follow under time pressure.
Balances project work with daily accounting operations to hit the next close deadline.
Defines how to deal with accounting errors and late adjustments without delaying close.

backlog.task: Map current quarter-end close activities and owners across bookkeeping and planning
definition_of_done: List of all quarter-end tasks documented with brief descriptions
Each task has an identified primary and backup owner role
Dependencies and handoffs between tasks are captured
Reviewed and confirmed by at least one bookkeeper and the accountant

backlog.task: Design standard journal entry template for recurring quarter-end postings
definition_of_done: Template includes mandatory fields for account, period, description, and supporting documents
Template reviewed for compliance with accounting conventions and tax legislation
Bookkeepers validate that the template is practical for daily use
Template stored in shared repository and linked in process documentation

backlog.task: Create quarter-end reconciliation checklist for key balance sheet accounts
definition_of_done: Checklist covers all critical balance sheet and control accounts
Each checklist item has clear completion criteria
Accountant reviews checklist for completeness and statutory coverage
Checklist tested on at least one prior quarter as a dry run

backlog.task: Draft quarter-end close calendar with milestones and cut-off times
definition_of_done: Calendar includes all major tasks, deadlines, and responsible roles
Dependencies with external stakeholders (e.g. banks, tax authorities) are noted
Calendar aligns with statutory filing deadlines
Approved by head of finance or accounting manager

backlog.task: Define exception handling process for late adjustments and accounting errors
definition_of_done: Process describes how to log, review, and approve late entries
Criteria for accepting or deferring adjustments are documented
Escalation path for high-impact issues is defined
Guideline shared with all bookkeepers and acknowledged

backlog.task: Compile reporting package structure for management review after close
definition_of_done: List of standard reports and financial statements is defined
Sequence and timing for report preparation is documented
Format and recipients for each report are specified
Accountant confirms that package meets statutory and internal needs

backlog.task: Review new process and templates against tax and commercial law requirements
definition_of_done: All process steps checked against statutory obligations
Any non-compliant steps corrected and re-documented
Summary of compliance checks recorded
Sign-off note added to process documentation

backlog.task: Pilot the streamlined close process on a prior quarter as a simulation
definition_of_done: Simulation executed using new checklist, templates, and calendar
Issues and bottlenecks logged during the pilot
Debrief session held with accountant and management assistant
List of improvement actions agreed and assigned

backlog.task: Prepare communication plan and quick reference guide for the finance team
definition_of_done: Key changes summarised in simple language
Quick reference guide created with links to all templates and checklists
Distribution list for communication agreed
Guide shared in central repository and referenced in Slack channel

backlog.task: Consolidate final quarter-end close process documentation and RACI matrix
definition_of_done: End-to-end process flow documented with steps and owners
RACI matrix completed for all major tasks
Document version-controlled and stored in shared location
Final review completed by head of finance or accounting manager

backlog.task: Set up tracking for close cycle timings and issues for the next quarter
definition_of_done: Simple log or sheet created to capture task completion times
Fields for issues, root causes, and follow-up actions defined
Team aligned on how and when to update the log
Log template shared in Slack and accessible to all stakeholders

backlog.task: Align quarter-end close process with annual budget and planning timelines
definition_of_done: Key planning and budgeting milestones mapped against close calendar
Conflicts and overlaps identified and documented
Mitigation actions agreed with financial planning stakeholders
Updated calendar shared and approved by finance leadership

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, key pain points, and confirm the quarter-end close workflow map.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for input on current close issues.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final list of quarter-end close activities and owners for T1.
Confirm which prior quarter will be used as reference for mapping and simulation.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and iterate on templates, checklists, and the close calendar.
threads_plan.trigger: Accountant shares first draft of journal entry template and asks for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard journal entry template in A8 for quarter-end use.
Lock in the quarter-end close calendar dates and cut-off times in A2.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define exception handling, compliance checks, and sign-off responsibilities.
threads_plan.trigger: Accountant posts draft of exception handling guideline and asks for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the approval flow for late adjustments and error corrections.
Confirm that the new process and templates pass the compliance review.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and debrief the pilot simulation of the streamlined close process.
threads_plan.trigger: Bookkeeper proposes dates and scope for running the mock close using new materials.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide on the exact pilot window and which tasks will be included in the simulation.
Agree on follow-up improvements based on pilot results and update artifacts accordingly.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize communication plan and rollout for the next quarter-end close.
threads_plan.trigger: Management assistant shares draft quick reference guide and communication plan.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the quick reference guide and decide how it will be distributed.
Confirm that the team will adopt the new process starting next quarter-end.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in during the project with each role posting priorities and blockers for the day.
Twice-weekly short review thread to track progress on backlog tasks and update A2 and A6.
Post-pilot retrospective thread after the mock close to capture lessons learned and action items.
Pre-quarter-end readiness check one week before close to confirm all artifacts and owners are in place.
